calls.title: GrowthBook & Breeze Commercial Discussion
calls.summary: The discussion centered on clarifying pricing and licensing options for Growth Book's enterprise and self-hosted solutions, with the enterprise package priced at $60,000 annually for five user seats, plus $1,000 for additional seats. This package includes features like JSON schema validation and dedicated support, but Vladyslav expressed concerns regarding the significant cost increase compared to their current usage. A self-hosted option, offering a 5% discount, brings the price to approximately $57,000 per year but requires enterprise licensing with no monthly billing. Upcoming changes to the Pro tier pricing model toward an event-based system may also affect customers like Vladyslav's team. Current usage is low, reinforcing budget concerns, and discussions will continue as Vladyslav consults with his leadership before making a decision.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, enterprise pricing, event-based model, feature flagging, self-hosting, product analytics
